title: Smoked Fish Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish that combines the richness of smoked fish with the spices of Syrian biryani.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic; sauté until onion is translucent.
Add cumin, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper; stir for 1 minute.
Add smoked fish; flake with a fork until fish is well-coated with spice mixture.
Add basmati rice; stir to combine with fish and spice mixture.
Add 2 cups of water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until rice is tender.
Fluff rice mixture with a fork; season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
